Food great, service very slow, meals out different times
Jan 2026 • Couples
Unfortunately I have to review this establishment at. 3, if it wasn’t for the food actually being of 4 star I probably would have given 1 star.

Arrived - 3 tables on balcony in use and 1 table inside so not overly busy as plenty of seating available. 

Waited for over 10 minutes after being seated and no one had come to take drink order, had to go ask.

Drinks we good, cold - shouldn’t be able to do too much wrong here 

Food - took a while to come and when it did my meal (rissoles & mash). The meal was delicious and hot. The rissoles were juicy and had great flavour and cooked perfect. 
Then I had finished my meal and my husbands had still not arrived. I asked waiter when it would come (not his fault he is not cooking) he said 10 more minutes and he apologised. I had to ask again where the meal was and he said not much longer, 2ins after I had finished eating husband’s meal if a medium steak arrived. His steak was cooked to perfection and his meal came out hot but who wants to go to dinner and eat separately. If I wanted that I’d go alone. 

Staff speak minimum English, they are polite but you have to go to them. They don’t come to you to see if you need another drink, if everything is ok. Customer service can make or break a place.

If they can improve on the staff service this could be a great place.

Avoid, Avoid and Avoid again.
Apr 2025 • Family
After reviewing several restaurants along the beach front, I chose the Mad Platter as the venue for our celebratory family seafood meal. I was quite disappointed and frustrated with my decision; it was certainly a letdown.

Upon arrival, we were seated and waited approximately five minutes for a waiter to take our drink orders, which included one Coke, two Sprites, and one draft Tiger beer. The drinks took ten minutes to arrive. It’s worth noting that the balcony area was full, with four staff members attending to about ten tables.

Eventually, we placed our food order, only to be informed that there would be a 45-minute wait for food. Our order included:
- Squid rings and fries (listed as separate items on the menu)
- Scallop spaghetti
- Steak risotto
- Seafood platter (BBQ option)

I requested that all dishes be served simultaneously, and the waiter agreed.

Ten minutes later, the squid rings arrived, which were essentially small breaded calamari rings reminiscent of supermarket offerings, and there were no fries. The remaining food arrived 40 minutes later.

Unfortunately, the seafood platter was quite unsatisfactory, leading me to leave around 70% of it uneaten due to concerns about its quality. The prawns were overcooked, the shellfish were slimy and covered in an overwhelming chili sauce, and the large shrimp was tough and excessively drenched in cheese sauce.

Additional observations:
During the wait, I witnessed one of the waiters sneeze into his hand and continue working without cleaning his hands. I inquired if he would be washing his hands but received no response. Moreover, there is an alleyway leading to the beach; about 20 people walked into the restaurant only to find they could not access the beach, prompting them to walk back through the restaurant.

The total bill was 2.6 million VND. I do not plan to return to this establishment and would hesitate to recommend it to others.
